faults.name: Pump or unit failure
faults.description: The pump laser or the unit fails and the output goes dark. Every channel carried by the unit is lost downstream. This is a hard failure. Field return rate about 1 per cent of units per year.

effects.scope: Every channel carried by the unit

faults.name: Gain loss
faults.description: The unit's gain falls below its set point. Output power is low on every channel, and, since the noise added is unchanged, the signal-to-noise ratio of every channel falls too. This is a gradual or step degradation rather than an outage. About 1 per cent of units per year.
faults.character: gradual or step degradation rather than an outage

faults.name: Pump ageing
faults.description: As the pump laser ages, the unit raises its drive current to hold the gain. Traffic is unaffected until the drive current reaches its limit; the trend gives early warning and leads eventually to the end-of-life alarm (AMP_PUMP_EOL). This is a slow, incipient condition. About 2 per cent of units per year.

effects.effect: raises its drive current to hold the gain
Traffic is unaffected until the drive current reaches its limit
leads eventually to the end-of-life alarm (AMP_PUMP_EOL)

faults.name: Gain tilt
faults.description: The gain is no longer flat across the band, so channels at one edge of the band arrive weaker than the others. Some channels are affected, not all. This is a degradation rather than an outage. About 0.5 per cent of units per year.

effects.scope: channels at one edge of the band
